scenes.sub: Separate exchanges and contracts from individuals before measuring concentration. Accumulation/distribution is inferred, not known. "Smart money" labels carry survivorship bias. Copying wallets ignores their hedges, size and private information.

scenes.sub: A "smart money" wallet buys a token. You don't see its perp short elsewhere; it may be hedged and farming. Copying the visible leg makes you the unhedged one.
